reviewCharts.warning: Wisconsin native review rows use ward-level presidential vote-share screening and presidential-versus-U.S. Senate same-party drop-off screening. Turnout rows use EAC 2024 V2 local-jurisdiction fallback data because the WEC ward results workbook does not include registered-voter denominator fields.

turnout.notes: Statewide Wisconsin turnout coverage uses official EAC 2024 EAVS V2 jurisdiction-level fallback rows. A1a is total registration and F1a is total voters; this is not the same denominator/source family as the WEC presidential contest vote total.

historicalBaselines.warning: Wisconsin historical baseline rows are county-level presidential results from 2012, 2016, and 2020 Wikipedia county tables with source footnotes. Use them as contextual baseline rows, not as 2024 certified data.
